title: Jennifer Thoss named Lytton's mayor after random draw breaks election tie

author: Erica Johnson, Ana Komnenic
description: An update to a Go Public investigation about Air Canada cancelling people’s flights due to 'safety-related maintenance,' using the perfectly good planes elsewhere, then denying passengers compensation. The federal transport minister was asked why this is allowed.
title: Transport minister questioned over Air Canada's use of safety exemption to deny compensation

author: Nicole Mortillaro
description: The super El Niño in the Pacific Ocean is living up to its forecast hype, and it hasn't even peaked yet. When it does, experts say its effects will be felt across Canada this winter.

author: Janet French
description: The first bill in the Alberta Legislature's fall sitting seeks to stop the provincial government and other public entities from considering diversity, equity and inclusion in hiring decisions, and to give victims recourse when someone shares intimate content of them without their consent.
title: Alberta bill would stop provincial entities from considering diversity, equity and inclusion in hiring

author: Ryan Cooke
description: Newfoundland and Labrador's citizens' representative says his office got a flood of complaints last week stating inmates at Her Majesty's Penitentiary in St. John's were not being given toothbrushes.
title: Watchdog sounds alarm after N.L.'s largest jail runs out of toothbrushes

description: U.S. and Cuban officials engaged in a stunning shouting match on the floor of the United Nations General Assembly on Tuesday, the latest in a series of public spats between the longtime adversaries over Washington's escalating economic campaign against Havana.

author: Julia Parrish
description: WARNING: This story contains graphic images of wildlife. Wildlife photographer Peter Mather said he was “shocked” to find a pair of bull caribou with antlers locked together, one of them dead, in the mountains south of Whitehorse earlier this month. He captured what happened as other wildlife fed off the carcass, still attached to the other bull.

author: Benjamin Shingler
description: Newly obtained internal data reveals a drop in experience levels at Station 39, where a group of officers were suspended this summer for alleged hateful and discriminatory acts. Experts and former police officers say a lack of veteran presence among patrol officers can lead to problems.

description: A 20-year-old Canadian who conned cryptocurrency holders out of millions of dollars — and lived large as a teenager in Florida with "extravagant" partying, access to a private jet and luxury cars — could soon be headed home to Canada after he pleaded guilty to a money laundering conspiracy and was sentenced to time served Monday.

author: Lauren Pelley
description: GLP-1s were designed and tested for long-term use, to combat chronic health conditions like diabetes and obesity. But what happens when you take these blockbuster weight loss drugs for a short stint? With more patients hopping on and off GLP-1s, scientists are trying to find out what that actually does to your body.

description: In many ways, the city council that's sworn in to lead Ottawa through the next four years will look very much like the last one — including the mayor's seat — but there were some important shifts.

description: Though he was born in New Westminster and raised in Surrey, Lorne Doerkson moved to the B.C. Interior as an adult, working for newspapers in Salmon Arm, Prince George and 100 Mile House before settling in Williams Lake in 2001. And he isn't shy about making his love for the region known.
